div.head: ECf 31a
div.ab: Et qui super ipsam dominabantur, uocabantur [þ]rehinggrefes, ad quos deferebantur cause que non poterant diffiniri in wapentagiis.
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 653 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page.

note.seg: trehiggreues Rl; trehiggres S; threhiggres Hr; trehinghef Hk [f wohl ursprünglich, vgl. Retr. Lond]; tþringe Ad
trehiggreues Rl; trehiggres S; threhiggres Hr; trehinghef Hk [f probably original, cf. Retr. Lond]; tþringe Ad

div.ab: And those who had lordship over it were called [þ]rehinggrefes (riding-reeves), to whom were brought the cases which could not be determined in the wapentakes.

note.seg: Besonderen Vogt (s. d. Gl 5 F) des Riding in Yorks. und des Part in Lincolns. kennt Ellis Domesday I 179. Vgl. Gl Instanzenzug 4c.
A special reeve (see that word in Gl 5 F) of the Riding in Yorks. and of the Part in Lincs. is known to Ellis Domesday I 179. Cf. Gl Instanzenzug 4c.
